content.value: A porter governor has links 150 mm long and are attached to pivots at a radial ( distance of 30 mm from the vertical axis of the governor. The mass of each ball is l.75 $\mathrm { K g }$ and the mass of the sleeve is 25 Kg. The governor sleeve begins to rise at 300 rpm when the links are at 30° to the vertical. Assuming the friction force to be $3 0 ^ { \circ }$ constant, find the maximum and minimum speed of rotation when the inclination of the links is $4 5 ^ { \circ }$ to the vertical.
